items.content:
Howdy y'all!

It's beginning to look a lot like FISHMAS in the Far Far West!

On December 3rd, we'll be releasing our next update, MERRY FISHMAS, bringing a little festive cheer (and a lot of fishing) to the frontier!

As you can probably guess from the name, this update is bringing FISHING to Far Far West, but you can also expect a bunch of other new content! Such as loadouts, weapon skins, UI changes, changes in how you'll unlock new maps, QOL improvements, bug fixes, and more!

A Festive Limited-Time Event

From December 3rd to Mid January, you'll be able to take on the Krumpus challenge, which will reward you with jingle bells that you use to unlock new festive cosmetics!

Also, just like our Halloween event, these cosmetics will remain permanently available after the event ends! However, they'll cost much more gold than regular cosmetics of the same rarity, so unlocking them during the Christmas event will be much faster!

So get those fishing rods ready, dust off your festive decorations, and prepare for a very Merry Fishmas.

items.title: DEVLOG - NOVEMBER
items.summary: Hello folks, Arno here! Cold days are just around the corner, and we’re preparing a whole bunch of new things to keep you busy while you wait endlessly for Christmas to be over at your parents’ house! From a complete UI overhaul to fishing,
items.content:
Hello folks, Arno here!

Cold days are just around the corner, and we’re preparing a whole bunch of new things to keep you busy while you wait endlessly for Christmas to be over at your parents’ house! From a complete UI overhaul to fishing, here we go!

⚠️ Everything below is WORK IN PROGRESS and might not ship as shown. We’re still cookin’ for now! ⚠️

🖼️ UI OVERHAUL & QUALITY OF LIFE

The whole UI of the game has been reworked! We got tired of the old brown buttons, which looked kinda cheap and clashed with how the game has evolved since release. We were stuck between two different art directions, and it was starting to look like a mess.

We’ve decided to switch to a more modern, more dynamic look, while keeping the sharp edges and that “torn” feeling the previous buttons had. We’ve also taken this opportunity to refine the layout of some UIs and make them clearer than before!

Layouts by @Spinker and @me, programming, design & implementation by @Spinker

Another addition that comes with this new UI is the use of tags. Tags will now be used EVERYWHERE. This lets us add detailed information to many UIs while keeping them clean and uncluttered. For instance, Jokers now tell you how many of them you can stack before it’s useless, or what their diminishing returns are!

Two more quality-of-life upgrades: you’ll now be able to use a quick chat with your mouse wheel, and equip up to 8 emotes!

This is only a sneak peek at all the quality-of-life upgrades we’ve made, and they’ll be covered more thoroughly in the update’s patch notes!

🎒 LOADOUTS

Wait, what? For real? After all this time? Yes indeed!

Loadouts are coming to the Far Far West and will let you instantly switch between builds, without the hassle of going back and forth between shops and moving Jokers from one weapon to another. No more need to buy a bunch of the same Joker to equip on all your weapons, and loadouts will also take your equipped spells into account!

Programmed by @teeto

The way loadouts are programmed also brings two changes we think you’ll like:

  • The hero shop has been removed, and your hero build can now be configured directly at the gunsmith shop

    [/*]

  • Weapon upgrades are no longer gained by leveling up your weapon, and specific upgrades are no longer bought individually. While the maximum number of upgrades hasn’t changed, you’ll now have to buy slots, then distribute/redistribute them freely between the different upgrades, without having to buy and sell them. This also means that when you unlock a new weapon, you’ll be able to use its 20 base slots right away, without having to level it up. This should definitely make the early levels of a weapon easier, as we know it’s quite hard to get through high difficulties and earn weapon XP with a brand-new, unleveled weapon

    [/*]

🎣 FISHING

At long last… after all these months… FISHING IS COMING!

It’s been requested a lot, and it’s a whole system of its own! You’ll have to travel across every map if you want to complete your collection, but you can also ignore all that and just fish with your friends in the lobby for hours! (It’s really soothing with that lil’ Christmas music, I can tell you)

⚔️ WEAPON SKINS

Weapon skins are coming!

We don’t want to churn out meh skins, so we’re focused on making every skin feel different from the base weapon, each with its own theme.

This means there won’t be a lot of skins to start with, but they’ll be GREAT! You can expect new skins to come out every now and then, and during seasonal events.

Implementation by @Spinker

  • Concept & 3D Model by @Capp, high-poly & rig by @Adrian, sounds by @Spinker

    [/*]

  • Concept, 3D Model and high-poly by @MashArt, rig by @Adrian

    [/*]

  • Concept & 3D Model by @Capp

    [/*]

  • Concept by @MashArt

    [/*]

    Concept, 3D Model and high-poly by @MashArt, rig by @Adrian

    ❔ QUEST SYSTEM REWORK

    With our latest update, we noticed three things:

    • People were OVERWHELMINGLY playing the 3 starting maps over and over

      [/*]

    • The Woodlands map was played by MANY people, since the new Lady Granny quest unlocks the newest map

      [/*]

    • Almost nobody was playing on Hellfire

      [/*]

    And that’s just not fun. A lot of people, especially new players, never get to see the other maps, each with its own mood and atmosphere, and returning players have to spend their whole session repeating the same map before finally getting a chance to move on to the newest one.

    We’re changing all that by no longer tying quests to unlocking a specific map. Instead, you’ll get 1 Quest token the first time you complete each quest.

    Since the game gives you more Quest tokens than you need to unlock every map, you no longer have to do EVERY quest in the game to unlock them all. So if you hate helping poor old grannies, you’re now free to completely ignore Lady Granny and let her die!

    Every map you haven’t unlocked yet will cost 3 Quest tokens. You can now straight up choose to unlock Hellfire as your first map and jump into the lava as a newbie if you want to! That’s way more fun!

    Map layout by @Capp and @Spinker

    ⛄ CHRISTMAS LOBBY

    CHRISTMAS TIMEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE!

    Level Art by @Borealis, atmosphere and snow system by @Spinker

    🍀 LUCK BUILD

    Luck is a new upgrade available on your hero and through a few Jokers, allowing you to influence the odds of a LOT of things!

    From the trigger chance of some Jokers to getting a good outcome at the wishing well, luck will come in handy! I know you’re already going to slap luck on top of your Stonks and Hoarder Jokers, don’t even try to pretend.

    💀 CRYPTIC TRAIN UPDATE

    Compared to the other Cryptic bosses, the Train was the one that didn’t need that much rework but rather just a quick

    New COMBAT FLOW, the Cryptic Train will now use different attacks during the fight.

    SKULL FRAG : Each wagon and the locomotive will release fragmentation skulls from both sides.

    Very Hard difficulty / Patterns by @Jonathan

    SKULL SHOOT : The train fires a volley of self-guided projectiles from its smokestack.

    Patterns by @Jonathan

    GHOST PASSIVE : When a locomotive or a wagon is destroyed, it becomes ghostly. This makes it immune to damage while still allowing it to attack.

    Patterns by @Jonathan

    🃏 SPELL JACK

    Spell Jack, a Far Far West take on the famous Blackjack, is also coming!

    It’s still very early in development, so there’s not much to show yet, and we’re not sure it’s going to be playable for the upcoming Christmas update, but who knows? Might as well leak it just in case.

    👋 SEE YOU LATER!

    The update should drop in early December, so stay tuned!

    THANK YOU for playing Far Far West and sticking with us <3

    See you in the next one.

    Arno

    Follow us through the West!

    Don’t forget to follow our socials

    JOIN OUR DISCORD

    Review FFW on Steam!! (pls <3)

    And check out the FFW OST!

Howdy y'all!

FEAR FEAR WEST IS OUT NOW!!!

We're super excited to get this one out into your wonderful hands! We've put a lot of hard work into today's update and hope y'all enjoy it. Please let us know what you think!

ALSO!! DISCOUNT!!

Starting RIGHT NOW, and for the next two weeks, Far Far West will also be going on sale for 20% off its usual price! So if you've been holding out on some spooky new content before jumping into the game, now might just be the time ;D

FEAR FEAR WEST EVENT

The Halloween event is here!

This means 3 new time-limited objectives, a new Halloween boss with exclusive attack patterns, a bunch of skins to unlock, and rituals to perform!

🎯 GAMEPLAY

The event takes place across all maps, with contracts on the mission selection listing if they have Halloween objectives or not

Each of these missions features up to 2 of the 3 unique resources, and each one has its own dedicated gameplay: 🪶 Feathers, 🎃 Pumpkins, and 💀 Skulls

    [/*]

Back in the lobby, head to the cauldron behind the train and use your resources to perform the ritual

Performing a ritual will reward you with 🕯️Haunted Candles, the event’s unique currency, which you can spend on Halloween-limited cosmetics!

FEATURES/CONTENT

⚔️ JOKER’S CHOICE

A small change, but one that feels BIG!

The pool of Jokers keeps getting wider, which means your chances of landing one that fits your build keep going down. Since melee and gun weapons often have their own specific Jokers, you’ll more and more often land one that’s completely useless to you, and that can only be broken down for Uranium or swapped at the Refiner.

We’re changing that!

  • Collecting a Joker is now instantaneous

    [/*]

  • When collecting a Joker, an interface will pop up and let you choose between 2 Jokers of the same rarity

    [/*]

  • All other Joker features remain unchanged

    [/*]

🚨 DISTURBANCE

We’re introducing scaling difficulty to Far Far West!

As players progressed through a mission and got stronger by collecting Jokers, it could feel like enemies were no longer a challenge, and the game got less fun as a result. We want players to still feel like they’ve become powerful, so the scaling is modest and should only serve to make missions a little more exciting and chaotic, rather than directly making the game more difficult.

For those who want difficulty, expect more challenge on new, higher difficulties in the future!

Completing specific actions during a mission will raise your Disturbance Level. At certain thresholds, enemies will be buffed for the rest of the mission

HOW TO INCREASE DISTURBANCE

    [/*]

🌀 MODIFIERS

Our modifier system has been through a lot of iterations during testing - in our previous devlogs, we showed off modifiers being directly tied to Disturbance Level, as a mandatory random challenge in every mission.

We felt this system wasn’t very friendly to casual players, and warped the game too much to be left up to random chance. This new system is fully opt-in, making you ask yourself: dare you strike a deal with the Dealmaker?

Modifiers can be activated within the game by finding and interacting with up to two Dealmakers. Each Dealmaker will offer you 2 modifiers to choose from, each modifier giving XP and Uranium based on its difficulty. The third modifier offered is random and has fixed rewards.

XP from Modifiers are applied to both your hero and weapons. If a modifier provides +500XP, you will individually gain +500XP on your hero, +500XP on your main weapon, and +500XP on your secondary weapon.

items.summary: Hello folks, Arno here! In this devlog, we’ll go more in-depth on our upcoming Halloween event, show a bunch of new things coming in the next update, and follow up on a few themes from previous devlogs! ⚠️ Everything below is WORK IN PROGRE
items.content:
Hello folks, Arno here! In this devlog, we’ll go more in-depth on our upcoming Halloween event, show a bunch of new things coming in the next update, and follow up on a few themes from previous devlogs!

⚠️ Everything below is WORK IN PROGRESS and might not ship as shown. We’re still cookin’ for now! ⚠️

🎃 HALLOWEEN EVENT

Our Halloween event is clooooooose! We’ve only been teasing it lightly so far, but we finally have more to share with you! Here’s what to expect: new time-limited objectives, a bunch of skins to unlock, resources to collect, rituals to accomplish, and a brand new Halloween-exclusive boss!

The Halloween event will be available on 3 maps: Far West, Area 41, and the new Redwood map

⚠️ We’ve changed our minds about how event cosmetics are unlocked compared to what we announced in our previous Devlog.

We thought vaulting the Halloween skins until next year’s event was a reasonable choice, and that it helped make the event feel special. But at the end of the day, that’s still FOMO, and we don’t want FOMO. So, Halloween cosmetics will NOT be vaulted when the event ends. Instead, they’ll go back to a gold price, but a much higher one than other cosmetics of the same category. This way the Halloween event stays the best and fastest way to unlock them, without being the only one! ⚠️

Concept and 3D by @Capp, rig and texture by @Adrian, animation by @Calu

The event will make you go through all 3 maps to collect exclusive Halloween resources, which you’ll then use to accomplish rituals in the lobby and earn the Halloween currency needed to unlock new skins!

The ominous cauldron in the lobby / Level Art by @Borealis

WIP Ritual accomplishment VFX / Animated and programmed by @Spinker, VFX by @me

For the new objectives and skins, we wanted something crooked, dark and naughty. A bunch of ~spooooooooky~ assets were made for the occasion!

Concept by @MashArt

Concept and 3D by @MashArt, rig and WIP texture by @Adrian

A new horse skin! / Concept by @MashArt

Concept, 3D and high-poly by @MashArt

Concept by @Capp, 3D by @Capp, @MashArt, @Spinker, high-poly and rig by @Adrian

🪚NEW MAIN OBJECTIVE

A new main objective is making its way into the Far Far West! This is our first step into adding new objectives, but definitely not the last! We’ll keep adding new main and secondary objectives in the coming updates to extend the existing pool and make sure every mission stays fresh. VERY WIP!!

WIP!! / Programmed by @Spinker

👵 GRANNY’S QUESTS

Granny’s getting impatient: you still haven’t done a thing for her while she rests behind the counter, counting her coins. 3 quests are currently being wrapped up, and completing them will unlock the Redwood map! She will make you work. Hard.

Lady Granny Quest 2 / Designed by @me, programmed by @Mylan

Lady Granny Quest 3 / Designed by @Spinker and @me, programmed by @Mylan and @Spinker

Concept and 3D by @MashArt

🌳 REDWOOD MAP

We finished the Redwood map, at last! It wasn’t an easy ride: the first time we thought it was done, we playtested it and… it didn’t work out. The map was gigantic and lacked detail on the ground, which made you feel like really small. It was also quite painful to traverse, and even a bit exhausting, enough that we were reluctant to do another run on the map. That’s definitely not what we’re aiming for in our maps, and we always want to be happy with what we deliver, even if it sets us back a few days or weeks.

Following this, we decided to cut the map by almost 40%, making areas narrower and more interesting to traverse, scaling down a bunch of meshes and adding a TON of vegetation. The map now feels like it belongs in Far Far West and is a blast to go through, while keeping its own unique features compared to the other maps!

Atmosphere by @Spinker, level art by @Borealis

👻 SPOOKYFICATION

In continuation of our goal to spookify the game a lil’ bit, a few points of interest and a handful of spots across the maps were overhauled, either because they were old and not up to par with how we do things now, or because they simply deserved to get spookied. This spookifying mission will continue in the coming updates, so expect more locations to get a makeover over time! Some Halloween-specific decorations may even stick around after the event ends.

Point of interest / By @Borealis

Point of interest / By @Borealis

Far West map church makeover / By @Borealis

🎶 ELECTRO… BANJO?

Telurik is the artist behind almost all the music in Far Far West! The electro banjo madness? That’s him! Telurik is now back with us part-time instead of from time to time, which means even more banger tracks coming in the next few months 🤌 And what better way to celebrate than a lil’ tease of the upcoming Halloween boss theme… 🎃

🐎 HORSE RAAAAAACE

A new mini-game has spawned in the lobby, and it’s NOT fishing! You can now race horses against your friends, soon to be enemies, and find out who’s the finest rider in the Far Far West 💨

WIP! / Designed and programmed by @Spinker

📰 SMALL THINGS!

We received a bunch of feedback about the Anna Wooltour skin from our previous Devlog, especially about her head compared to her original design by @EarlGoupil (community). So we’ve remade her head in a way that fits the original design a bit better!

BEFORE

AFTER

The Disturbance system and the modifiers that go along with it were presented in our previous devlog, but they were still WIP at the time. Well, here’s a batch of new icons made just for the new modifiers, as well as a few WIP names to chew on!

Modifier icons by @Capp

Also… we’re having seasonal title screens from now on!

Background by @Borealis

👋 SEE YOU LATER!

Happy start of the spooky season!

THANK YOU for playing Far Far West and sticking with us <3

See you in the next one. Arno 🎩

items.summary: Hello folks, Arno here! In this devlog, we’re talking about new systems, difficulty, replayability, reworks, as well as a lot of new cool visual things to look at while we’re preparing for our Halloween update! ⚠️ Everything below is WORK I
items.content:
Hello folks, Arno here!

In this devlog, we’re talking about new systems, difficulty, replayability, reworks, as well as a lot of new cool visual things to look at while we’re preparing for our Halloween update!

⚠️ Everything below is WORK IN PROGRESS and might not ship as shown. We’re still cookin’ for now! ⚠️

🃏 JOKERS CHOICE!

A small change, but one that feels BIG! The pool of Jokers keeps getting wider, which means your chances of landing one that fits your build keep going down. Since melee and gun weapons often have their own specific Jokers, it happens more and more that a Joker is completely useless to you and has to be either broken down for Uranium or swapped at the Refiner. Well, you’ll now get to choose between 2 Jokers every time one drops!

Design and implementation by @Spinker

Obviously, having more choices also means that you’ll more often have a build that fits you, and thus the game will be easier in general. Well, don’t worry, difficulty is also a big topic of this devlog and of the next update! Let’s go to the second topic ⏩

⛈️ DISTURBANCE SYSTEM - DIFFICULTY / REPLAYABILITY

We’ve been wondering about the current state of the difficulty in Far Far West for quite some time, and considering we have a diverse range of players, everybody has a different opinion on what the difficulty should be. Before making any change, we thought it was wise to ask you on different platforms whether you felt Far Far West needed to be more difficult. The poll answers as well as discussions that ensued were extremely interesting, and just as planned, pretty much everyone wants something different. We are also aware that a big part of our community is made of casual players who do not follow us on socials, and that, being casual players, they would probably lean towards not wanting the game to be harder. We’re taking this into account too! So how do we please everyone? We can’t. But we’ll do our best to make as many people happy as possible!

Discord vote / Reddit vote / Twitter vote

Both a replayability and difficulty system at once, the Disturbance system will arrive with the next update! Disturbance will take into account what you accomplish on the map, and at some point will apply a modifier to your game. What, you thought the Overseer was just sassy and not doing anything all this time, just waiting for his minions to be defeated? He was preppin’ his modifiers, indeed!

Modifiers will be separated into two categories, “Easy” and “Hard”, and the modifiers that are applied will be based on the difficulty of the mission selected and the tier of Disturbance reached. In practice, the higher the difficulty you choose, the harder the modifiers you get. This allows us to make sure the base difficulty of the game is not impacted too much at any difficulty level, while still adding a ton of replayability for everyone. Along with the Joker choice coming in the next update as well, we believe this increase in difficulty is going to balance itself out and make most people happy!

Thanks to everyone who participated and shared modifier ideas in our Discord, we read everything and a bunch made their way into the game!

Disturbance & modifiers can be tracked next to your minimap

Gary’s modifier. He’s Gary. Programmed by @Spinker

Farmyard modifier. They’re bad, bad chickens. Programmed by @Spinker

Still, this update on difficulty is not enough of a challenge for a bunch of people, and we hear ya! At this stage, we’re still considering adding a new difficulty level above Nightmare that would be extremely difficult and unfair, and not supposed to be played by most people. The goal of this difficulty would be to offer a real challenge to the best Far Far West players, without touching all the other difficulties, and therefore all the players who already find the game hard enough. Stay tuned!

This is the first step towards end-game content, but definitely not the last!

☠️ CRYPTIC BOSSES REWORK

As stated in our 🚅PUBLIC ROADMAP, Cryptic bosses are getting reworked, considering how the game has evolved since release and everything we’ve learned from your feedback. You can expect them to have more patterns, to be less frustrating and overall more interesting! Here’s a deeper dive into our changes for the Saloon and the Vulture, and you can expect the same level of work on the Necromancer and the Train.

Rig by @Adrian, animation by @Calu, patterns by @Jonathan, Gameplay by @Arno

⭐ What is wrong with current Saloon?

  • It can be damaged only through its planks, rendering most builds inefficient and frustrating to use against

    [/*]

  • It has no evolution between difficulties

    [/*]

  • The second phase with the saloon spirit is boring but also confusing for first-time players

    [/*]

  • Not really a monster house fantasy?

    [/*]

⭐ What do we change?

  • It can now be damaged everywhere, planks remain through the fight and are now used as weakspots

    [/*]

  • New patterns for Very Hard and Nightmare, the boss cycle through attacks with a speed based on difficulty

    [/*]

  • No second phase anymore

    [/*]

  • New animations, new patterns and overall more visual clarity!

    [/*]

Rig by @Adrian, animation by @Calu, patterns by @Jonathan, Gameplay by @Arno

⭐ What is wrong with current Vulture?

  • The boss never moves

    [/*]

  • It has no evolution between difficulties

    [/*]

items.summary: Far Far West is in a solid place right now, with the developers planning several more updates that include additional missions, new cosmetics to earn and much, much, more.
items.content:
Over the last few weeks, I’ve been playing Far Far West , a new co-op shooter that’s currently available in early access. Thus far, I’ve had a fun time with the game, but it still has some way to go before it’s ready for prime time.

Far Far West is structured into rounds that see you completing objectives to summon a boss. Defeating this boss allows you to extract from the location before doing it again in a different map. Each location also includes side objectives to complete and resources to collect. Oh, and you’ll want to collect these resources and take time to complete the additional objectives because doing so will help you unlock new weapons and upgrade abilities.

This is a simple yet effective gameplay loop that shines best while playing with friends. However, I also found myself enjoying single-player runs nonetheless, thanks to the core gameplay mechanics. It’s a first-person shooter that combines the use of guns with spells, all of which level up the more you use them. Shooting works as you’d expect from any modern shooter game: hold the left trigger to aim down sight and press the right trigger to fire.

The game gives you two weapons, a main gun and a sidearm. To start with, you'll have a simple machine gun and revolver. Once you progress enough, you’ll be able to unlock several other choices of weapons, from a shotgun to a minigun and much more. These are unlocked by finding the correct weapon parts, which is done by defeating bosses and in various other ways that I won’t spoil here.

What sets Far Far West apart from a typical co-op shooter of this style is the ability to use spells. Nothing ever beats throwing a fireball directly into a boss's face after all. Similar to the guns, you’ll begin with two spells, one fire-based and the other acid-based. Using these spells will level them up, and as they level up, you’ll be able to upgrade them for stronger spells that do different things. Thankfully, they are simple to activate as well, with a press of either the left or right bumper, depending on which spell you want to use. These spells also have a relatively short recharge time that feels well-balanced to avoid spamming without minimizing player choice.

From a presentational standpoint, Far Far West will disappoint some players due to the lack of voiced dialogue, which I would like to see added before the full launch as it would provide some additional personality. However, outside of that, the audio and visuals of Far Far West are really fun. The steampunk/western aesthetics remind me of the Steamworld franchise, but the character models and animations constantly made me think of Sea of Thieves. Neither of those is a bad thing, and in truth, that mix of elements makes Far Far West feel unique. Although I will admit that I would like to see a little bit more variation in the games’ color palette.

Right now, most of the color comes from spells from the different enemies, such as skeletons or some annoying birds. The environments themselves appear mostly brownish-orange, which is obviously in keeping with the western theme.

Audio goes largely unnoticed, but that’s because everything sounds as it should; guns have a nice twang and bang that fits well with the visual design. Music is understated but ramps up suitably during boss fights and extraction moments, providing some tension where it is most needed.

Far Far West is in a solid place right now, with the developers planning several more updates that include additional missions, new cosmetics to earn and much, much, more. I’d say that, unless you are really starving for another co-op shooter to play with friends, this one will definitely be far, far more worth waiting for until closer to its full release.

I’m Jordan I have a background in game design and am deeply passionate about accessibility in gaming. My favourite games/franchises include Shenmue, Red Dead Redemption 2, Plague Tale: Requiem, Metal Gear Solid 3, Yakuza, Splinter Cell, and Assassin’s Creed.

Welcome to Friday! As we finished this missive, news of Nintendo putting Switch 2 prices up by $50 to $500 (and by a higher % in Japan) just hit, alongside PlayStation’s results that saw PS5 “ship 1.5m units this quarter, down from 2.8m last year.” (We’ll have more on Tuesday, but console crunches continue…)

And before we start, it’s back: “This year’s My Famicase Exhibition [ in Tokyo] features 250 art pieces of fictional games, displayed on physical Nintendo Famicom game cartridges” , and Super Punch rounds up successful designs ( more on Instagram ), including one, Mecha Mech by GameDiscoverCo logo/website designer VictoryOverAll (congrats!)

[ FREE DEMO OF GDCo PRO? You too can get a gratis demo of our GameDiscoverCo Pro company-wide ‘Steam deep dive’ & console data by contacting us today - >95 orgs have it. Or, signing up to GDCo Plus gets the rest of this newsletter and Discord access, plus more .]

Let’s finish things out for this week by looking at mucho game platform and discovery news, like this:

According to ICO’s Footprints.gg and its ‘trad media’ coverage , GTA 6 hit the top spot again thanks to Take Two’s Strauss Zelnick saying not-much in multiple interviews . (But it’s still on schedule!) Also hot: PlayStation exclusive Saros, Xbox’s multiplatform hit-in-the-making Forza 6, Subnautica 2, and more…

Xbox’s new boss Asha Sharma is making major exec changes , “bringing over execs from the CoreAI engineering group where she worked before, along with a director at her previous company, Instacart.” But there’ll be less AI in the product , as Xbox will “begin winding down Copilot on mobile and will stop development of Copilot on console.”

Fresh via the Curran Games Agency , we have a new pricing tool for Steam games to try out, with Cassia Curran noting of the underlying data: “If few reviewers mention a game's price (neither complaining nor gushing over great value), it's likely to have higher revenues and is probably priced correctly.”

Some new stats from an IGN & friends report polling ‘highly committed’ fans: “38% of Millennials (people aged 30 – 44) and 42% of Gen Z (those aged 14 – 29) said they still buy full-price games, but only 20% Gen X (people aged 46 – 61) said they would.” There’s a lot of discounted games & not a lot of time, folks…

After rampant site errors during the Steam Controller’s debut, Valve is instituting a reservation queue for upcoming Controller purchases , like Steam Deck, a ‘good idea’: “Once you reserve, your place in line will be saved. When we go back in stock, order emails will be sent in the same order that reservations were made.”

In ‘surprising platforms investing in games’ news, Google Deepmind is partly behind EVE Online parent CCP spinning off Pearl Abyss , with Deepmind’s Demis Hassabis excited to: “advance AI research safely inside a player-driven universe as amazingly complex as EVE Online.” (Via those famously normal EVE Online players .)

Discovery trend news: an analysis on why ‘tavern games’ are hot - “12 [out of] 22 of the released games made over $100k” ; a look at how IndieGameJoe has been making game promo Tweets go viral - yes, in 2026; good analysis of announcing real-time roguelite strategy game Everfront - spoiler, it was r/godot which did best for ‘em!

Steam oddities: did you know the More Like This game page recommendations, like New & Trending, seems to be subtly region-specific? (It’ll be 80-90% similar worldwide, but with slight changes in the UK vs. the U.S., for example?) We had to change our recent write-up and Pro data labeling to indicate as much….

Windows vs. SteamOS news: while an Ars Technica editorial suggests : “the RAMpocalypse has bought Microsoft valuable time in the fight against SteamOS” , Windows Central has a piece on ‘Windows K2’ , noting Microsoft “is working to optimize the platform so.. steamOS and Windows gaming performance are comparable.”
